* '''Playtest''' ([[Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscantprivateplatform.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.”
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant: Private Platform (Docking Bay)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscantprivateplatform.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words. On 2 August 2019 the PC re-uploaded the same image turned 90° (Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190802-d24ffc3.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d24ffc3/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/coruscantprivateplatform.gif Holotable commit d24ffc3 “Flipped sites”]), no mark). Turned back, it is the same image with the same words, so it is not a separate version (an image that only re-orients a printing is a note on that printing; Bill, 25 November 2026).
*: [[File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): '''First published 29 March 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscantprivateplatform.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/168657ac16eea2f516349595d99cda7cd8f849f3 commit 168657a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-coruscantprivateplatform.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/coruscantprivateplatform.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: Light Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 2 Force (1 if Obi-Wan present).” Dark Side: “Your docking bay transit from here requires 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution (new credit line “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”).
